reviews.author: bowow
reviews.text: Tak si rikam jen "proc". Proste...... Proc. Kdyz album tocili, dostali jasny dotaz na broadway. A zaznelo jasne ne. A pak se neco stalo. Tohle uz zdaleka neni punk, to uz neni ani zblizka rock, tohle je cista komerce. Tri hvezdy za dokonalou rockovou desku American Idiot a "mamtonasalamu" pristup BJ. Na druhou stranu to uplne chapu-prilezitost vyzkouset neco nove. "When you have the f*****g chance man, you do it, man." Trochu se obavam, ze timto tempem (deska->broadway->film) se v horizontu peti let dockame i splneni Mikova "snu" o adaptaci desky v ledni revue. A to bych nezvladla dokoukat ani trailer. A to slovo nemohu dostat z hlavy - komerce. "Wake me up, when the broadway show ends."(01.02.2017)
